notes: Recurring SecondQuest cast, shared by every episode. Paths starting with '/' are relative to public/. All character art: transparent PNG/WebP, feet (or base) touching the bottom edge, no drop shadow (the engine adds contact shadows). Deliver at 2x the largest on-screen size; the asset report (npm run assets) lists the recommended pixel size for each file.

quest.bed_sleeping.label: asleep in bed
quest.bed_sleeping.brief: Quest asleep in a single bed under a blanket, 3/4 view. Bed included in the cut-out. Curly hair spilling on pillow.

quest.bed_awake.label: jolted awake in bed
quest.bed_awake.brief: Same bed and framing as quest_bed_sleeping (must overlay exactly). Quest bolt upright, eyes wide, hair messy, one hand slapping toward the alarm (screen right).

quest.desk_typing.label: typing at office desk
quest.desk_typing.brief: Red hoodie, seated at an office desk with monitor and keyboard (desk included), 3/4 view facing screen left, tired neutral face, hands on keyboard.

quest.holding_paycheck.label: holding paycheck, pleased
quest.holding_paycheck.brief: Standing, holding a paycheck up with both hands, small satisfied smile.

quest.looking_up_awe.label: looking up in awe
quest.looking_up_awe.brief: Standing, head tilted way back looking up screen-right, mouth open, tiny in the face of something enormous.

quest.exhausted_slumped.label: slumped on couch, exhausted
quest.exhausted_slumped.brief: Collapsed on a couch (couch included), arms limp, eyes half closed, bag dropped at feet. End-of-workday energy.

quest.farmer_gaming.label: farmer cap + gamepad, wide awake
quest.farmer_gaming.brief: SAME couch/framing as quest_exhausted_slumped (swap must overlay). Now sitting forward, farmer cap on, gamepad in hands, eyes bright and focused on TV (screen right).

quest.tractor_side.label: driving tractor (side view)
quest.tractor_side.brief: Quest in farmer cap driving a mid-size green tractor, side view facing screen left, both hands on wheel. Reused as the tiny tractor in the giant-field shot.

quest.action_hero.label: action-hero fantasy
quest.action_hero.brief: Quest in helmet and tactical vest over the hoodie, holding a chunky toy-like blaster, heroic pose. Comedic, not violent.

quest.knight.label: knight fantasy
quest.knight.brief: Quest in shiny armor with the red hoodie visible underneath, sword raised, gallant pose.

quest.tractor_heroic.label: heroic low angle on tractor
quest.tractor_heroic.brief: Low-angle hero shot: Quest on the tractor seat, farmer cap, squinting at the horizon like a final boss awaits. Tractor front grille dominant.

quest.farmer_planting.label: planting crops
quest.farmer_planting.brief: Farmer cap, kneeling/bending to plant seedlings, satisfied focus.

quest.farmer_fertilizer.label: hauling fertilizer
quest.farmer_fertilizer.brief: Farmer cap, pushing a wheelbarrow loaded with fertilizer sacks, effortful but happy.

quest.farmer_feeding.label: feeding animals
quest.farmer_feeding.brief: Farmer cap, tossing feed from a bucket, a few chickens at his feet (included).

quest.excited.label: genuinely, hugely excited
quest.excited.brief: Farmer cap, both fists up, sparkling eyes, open-mouth grin. Pure joy over a vehicle.

quest.sitting_back.label: seen from behind, looking over farm
quest.sitting_back.brief: Back view: Quest sitting (on the fence line), farmer cap, red hoodie, curly hair visible, relaxed shoulders. Quiet, contemplative.

wallet.happy.label: happy, full of cash
wallet.happy.brief: Wallet character stuffed with bills, beaming.

wallet.worried.label: worried, sweating
wallet.worried.brief: Same wallet, now thin, sweating, eyes darting. Must overlay wallet_happy.

wallet.fainted.label: fainted flat
wallet.fainted.brief: Wallet flat on its back, X eyes / swirl eyes, one moth fluttering out.

progress.cheering.label: cheering, bar at 100%
progress.cheering.brief: Progress robot (progress-bar body) arms up, bar full and glowing.

grind.wheel.label: hamster wheel
grind.wheel.brief: The Grind: a hamster wheel on a stand, side view, empty. Spoked so rotation reads.

fear.peeking.label: peeking, trembling
fear.peeking.brief: Fear character peeking from screen edge, trembling, big anxious eyes.

brand.wordmark.label: SecondQuest wordmark
brand.wordmark.brief: Official SecondQuest logo / wordmark, transparent. Until supplied the engine sets a typographic placeholder.
